sources.name: Chicago Energy Benchmarking (City of Chicago data portal, xq83-jr8c)
Chicago Energy Benchmarking - Covered Buildings (City of Chicago data portal, g5i5-yz37)
Boundaries - Community Areas (City of Chicago data portal, igwz-8jzy)
Building Footprints (City of Chicago data portal, syp8-uezg)

data_year.label: Data year
data_year.definition: The benchmarking data year every figure describes.

covered.label: Covered properties
covered.definition: Properties the ordinance covered for 2022: rows of energy.csv.

drawn_as_footprints.label: Drawn as footprints
drawn_as_footprints.definition: Covered properties whose located_by is footprint: placed by its largest attached City footprint.

drawn_as_markers.label: Drawn as markers
drawn_as_markers.definition: Covered properties whose located_by is trusted_coordinate: placed by a City coordinate that passed the community-area test or was accepted on review, having no confirmed footprint.

not_mapped.label: Not mapped
not_mapped.definition: Covered properties whose located_by is none: placed by neither a footprint nor a coordinate that passed the test.

reported_no_eui.label: Reported with no EUI published
reported_no_eui.definition: Submitted rows with an empty site_eui_kbtu_sq_ft; no total is formed for them.

reported_with_eui.label: Reported with a site EUI
reported_with_eui.definition: Submitted rows with a site EUI, the population every total and class break is computed over.

gfa_inflated.label: Reported properties with inflated floor area
gfa_inflated.definition: Reported rows with an EUI whose gfa_consistent is false: EUI times floor area runs 3% or more above the fuel total.

campuses_reporting.label: Reporting properties with more than one building

eui_over_1000.label: Reported properties above 1,000 kBtu per square foot
eui_over_1000.definition: Submitted rows with site_eui_kbtu_sq_ft above 1,000, kept as published.

total_site_energy.label: Total reported site energy
total_site_energy.definition: site_energy_kbtu summed over reported properties: each property's reported fuel use, added up.

eui_x_gfa_overstatement_pct.label: Overstatement by EUI times floor area
eui_x_gfa_overstatement_pct.definition: Summed eui_x_gfa_kbtu over summed site_energy_kbtu, minus one, over reported properties with a total.

median_site_eui.label: Median site EUI
median_site_eui.definition: Median site_eui_kbtu_sq_ft over the 2,562 reported properties with one.

matched_high_medium.label: Reported properties matched at high or medium confidence
matched_high_medium.definition: Submitted properties whose match_confidence is high or medium.

matched_high_medium_pct.label: Share matched at high or medium confidence

match_target_pct.label: Match target set before matching
match_target_pct.definition: The release bar the reconciliation states, met or not: the share of reported properties at high or medium confidence.

precision_reviewed.label: Matches checked for precision
precision_reviewed.definition: Rows of match_review.csv: the seeded sample of footprint matches checked one by one.

precision_drawn_pct.label: Drawn outlines on the right building
precision_drawn_pct.definition: Population-weighted precision of the outlines the map draws, from the verdicts in match_review.csv (correct or one building of a campus, over correct plus wrong).

precision_high_pct.label: High-confidence matches on the right building
precision_high_pct.definition: Population-weighted precision of the high-confidence matches, from the verdicts in match_review.csv (correct or one building of a campus, over correct plus wrong).

precision_medium_pct.label: Medium-confidence matches on the right building
precision_medium_pct.definition: Population-weighted precision of the medium-confidence matches, from the verdicts in match_review.csv (correct or one building of a campus, over correct plus wrong).

built_after_footprints_no_outline.label: Reported properties built after 2015 with no outline
built_after_footprints_no_outline.definition: Submitted properties with no footprint_ids and a year_built after 2015.

footprint_vintage_year.label: Footprint layer vintage
footprint_vintage_year.definition: The newest year_built in the City's building footprint layer, a 2015 snapshot.

overrides.label: Properties resolved on review
overrides.definition: Rows of footprint_overrides.csv: matches the tiers could not settle, resolved one at a time against named evidence.

overrides_placed.label: Resolved properties placed
overrides_placed.definition: Override rows with footprint_ids or a coordinate.

overrides_unplaced.label: Resolved properties left unplaced
overrides_unplaced.definition: Override rows with neither footprints nor a coordinate: a veto.

floor_area_tolerance_pct.label: Floor-area consistency tolerance
floor_area_tolerance_pct.definition: A record is floor-area consistent where EUI times floor area is within this of the fuel total.

n_classes.label: Color classes
n_classes.definition: Quantile classes per metric, computed once at build time and published in classes.json.

hex_width.label: Density hexagon width
hex_width.definition: 400 meters flat to flat, in feet.

hex_with_value.label: Hexagons with a value
hex_with_value.definition: density_hex.csv rows with a site_energy_kbtu: hexagons holding a reporting property with a total.

hex_one_property.label: Hexagons with a value that hold one reporting property
hex_one_property.definition: Of the hexagons with a value, those whose n_submitted is 1.

ca_under_five.label: Community areas with fewer than five reporting properties
ca_under_five.definition: density_ca.csv rows whose n_submitted is below 5.

energy_csv_mb.label: Size of energy.csv
energy_csv_mb.definition: Its size in bytes divided by 1,000,000.

buildings_csv_mb.label: Size of buildings.csv
buildings_csv_mb.definition: Its size in bytes divided by 1,000,000.
